name: smwmusic-tetris-battle-gaiden-haunted-house
title: Tetris Battle Gaiden - Haunted House
description:
This is from Tetris Battle Gaiden, a competitive puzzle-battle game, similar to games such as Puzzle Fighter or Puyo Puyo. It was also released waaaaay back before Puyo Puyo Tetris (The most epic crossover game EVER!) came into the shelves.

For this port, it's an upbeat and spooky-lookin' Halloween-themed song for your haunted level needs! Happy Halloween, everyone!

This song was part of Wyatt's music pack, and was resubmitted separately after the remoderation for ease of search and to fit current standards.

StackDino's Edits:
• Converted to amk 2;
• Added more tags;
• Decreased insertion size;
• Removed unnecessary rest "r16/".
